name: Tigo DC Nicaragua / Flexenclosure eCentre Managua
notes: Flexenclosure/eSite release says it completed a new eCentre data center for Tigo Business in Managua; DCD confirms completion for Millicom's Tigo operation and notes modular expansion range 100 kW to 10 MW but no stated facility power capacity.

name: Navegalo Nicaragua Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists the facility at 14 Carr. a Masaya, 10000 Managua, offering colocation, dedicated servers, cloud servers, VPS, redundant connectivity and managed services; listing title reports 1 MW.

name: OPTIM Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists OPTIM Data Center within Managua as the first Nicaraguan modular data center, a 40-foot container designed for Tier III certification with colocation/cloud/bare-metal services and 5 kW max power per rack on specs page.

name: Centro de Datos Academico de las Universidades miembros del CNU
notes: UNAN-Managua official article reports the inauguration at UNAN-Managua of a high-technology Academic Data Center for CNU member universities, with investment stated in the article metadata as more than 129,000 million cordobas.
